title: Precheck misses tests the gate runs differently
what: The worker's quiet check is pytest with -k; the gate runs every library test under plain python3 and the registry test test_rules_gate.RuleTestsComplete. 28 Oct, wf_a74e8dbc-fb9: py-green f8b4fee added tests importing pytest (ModuleNotFoundError under the gate); doctor-exit 4ba4199 made tests.test_setup.Setup read the rules folder without listing it in relay_textonly.RULE_TESTS. `relay precheck` was green on both; the gate went red: about 118 lane minutes and $0.29 of fixers.
why: Twice in one run, two shapes, one rule (principle 6): the quiet check runs changed tests with another runner and a narrower set than the gate.
failing_case: `relay precheck` on f8b4fee or 4ba4199 is green; the gate on them is red.
pass_cases: relay precheck runs the test files changed on the branch under plain python3 (the gate's runner) and RuleTestsComplete, and is red on both shas with the gate's message.
A branch that changes no test file adds under 5 s to precheck.
A changed test that passes keeps precheck green; one too slow for STEP_TIMEOUT is a red line, not a skip.
